entries.design: slate blue shark egg with cream lower jaw patch, two tiny dark eyes and a short toothy mouth motif; small simple dorsal fin nub on top and short side fin nubs
entries.prompt: Create ONE Minecraft spawn egg inventory sprite. Reference image 1 is the user's desired STYLE sheet: match its compact mob-themed egg icons, coarse chunky square pixel clusters, restrained 4-6 shades per material, dark colored stepped outline, top-left highlight, flatter front-facing readable design. Reference image 2 is the ACTUAL TEXTURED MODEL for mob colors and distinctive features. Design: slate blue shark egg with cream lower jaw patch, two tiny dark eyes and a short toothy mouth motif; small simple dorsal fin nub on top and short side fin nubs. Main body must be an upright oval EGG, wider near bottom and narrower rounded top; do not depict the complete animal or a 3D model. Animal motifs decorate the egg shell just like user sheet. Match sheet's low logical pixel density, approximately 16-24 logical pixels high, crisp hard-edged flat pixel art, no fine texture or glossy rendering. Centered single icon occupying roughly 75 percent of square canvas, generous transparent margins. No UI cell, labels, border, ground, shadow, props, other icons or background; true transparent background. This asset will be downscaled to 64x64.
